newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-Nov fishmeal exports fall 20 pct vs 95.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-Nov fishmeal exports fall 20 pct vs 95.

text.p: Chilean fishmeal exports fell to one million tonnes in the first 11 months of last year, against 1.26 million tonnes in the same period 1995, said the Fishing Subsecretariat.
Exports from neighboring Peru also fell, although for different reasons, said the statement.
"In Chile, the impact was the result of lower production of fishmeal from horse mackerel and anchovy, while in Peru anchovy catches fell," said the statement.
Chile and Peru account for 78 percent of the world's fishmeal production.

But a 23 percent increase in fishmeal prices over the last year meant that the value of Chile's fishmeal exports fell only slightly to $582 million in the first 11 months of the year from $590 million in the same period 1995.
Fishmeal, which is used as animal feed, accounts for one third of Chile's fishing exports.

Chilean fishing exports totalled $1.7 billion in the January - November period, down two percent on the first 11 months of 1995. Export volumes fell 15 percent to 1.4 million tonnes with higher prices making up for the lower shipments.
